title: fix: discarded-issue job and pre-labelled PRs in Dev
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
Two small fixes to the repo organization automation.

- The hourly job that closes Dev issues marked `Discarded` read only the first 100 of ~5,400 project items. It now searches open issues in the Dev project instead: open issues are all it can close, and the org-wide search still covers issues from other repos (e.g. `pollinations/admin`). Test run: checked 163, closed 0
- A PR opened with a kind label already set (e.g. #15394) skipped the Dev project along with the labelling, so it never showed in the PR view. The project add now happens first

gist.headline: The lost PRs found Dev
gist.blurb: The repo gardener stopped inspecting only the first shelf of a very large issue cupboard. Discarded Dev issues are now found through open-issue search, and pre-labelled PRs get their rightful spot in the project view.
gist.summary: Repo automation now searches open Dev-project issues instead of only the first 100 of roughly 5,400 project items when closing Discarded issues, and adds pre-labelled PRs to the Dev project before label handling can skip them.
gist.impact: Maintainers get reliable cleanup across organization repositories and can see already-kind-labelled PRs in the Dev project view immediately.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy project garden has a large filing shelf of issue cards, with Polli using a magnifying glass to find cards marked Discarded among open-issue flowers; a pre-labelled PR card is being placed into the Dev project board first. This represents replacing the shallow 100-item scan with an open-issue search and ensuring labelled PRs are still added to the board.
